# Background & aims

1.  

# Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(APCalign)
library(terra) # used to extract and process rasters
library(glmmTMB)
library(easystats)


data <- read_csv("data/AVH_records/AVH_plant_height_data_check_for_units_20251117.csv") |>
  filter(first_order == "keep", second_order == "keep", is.na(flag_value)) |>
  select(any_of(c("family", "species", "decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude", "height_with_units", "units", "trait_name", "minimum_aligned", "maximum_aligned", "mean_aligned", "species_minimum", "species_maximum", "species_mean", "occurrenceRemarks", "habitat", "eventDate", "year", "recordNumber", "institutionCode", "row_number")))

data |> select(any_of(c("minimum_aligned", "maximum_aligned", "mean_aligned"))) |> mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ !(is.na(.x)))) %>% mutate(n = . |> rowSums()) |> pull(n) |> table()


```


## Get climate covariates

Load climate covariates from worldclim

- BIO_1: "Annual Mean Temperature" — the average temperature (°C) over the year for a location.
- BIO_12 is a bioclimatic variable representing "Annual Precipitation." 


```{r}
vars <- c("wc2.1_2.5m_bio_1.tif", "wc2.1_2.5m_bio_12.tif")

# Australia
australia <- terra::rast("data/australia.tif")

# Stacked raster of climate predictors, cropped to Australia
stacked_rasters <-
  # list.files(wc_path, full.names = TRUE, pattern = ".bil") |>
  file.path("data/spatial/climate/worldclim/wc2.1_2.5m_bio", vars) |>
  terra::rast() |>
  terra::crop(australia)
```


```{r}
austraits_geo <-
  data |>
  # Remove problematic values
  filter(
    !is.na(decimalLatitude), !is.na(decimalLongitude)
  )

# Add climate data
trait_data_vect <-
  austraits_geo |>
  select("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude") |>
  terra::vect(
    geom = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"),
    crs = terra::crs(stacked_rasters)
  )

data_traits_climate <-
  terra::extract(x = stacked_rasters, y = trait_data_vect, method = "simple", bind = TRUE, cells = FALSE, ID = FALSE, dataframe = TRUE) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  bind_cols(austraits_geo) |>
  rename(decimal_longitude = `decimalLongitude`, decimal_latitude = `decimalLatitude`, annual_precipitation = wc2.1_2.5m_bio_12, average_temperature = wc2.1_2.5m_bio_1) |>
  select(decimal_longitude, decimal_latitude, annual_precipitation, average_temperature, everything()) |>
  mutate(
    taxon_name = species,
    log_annual_precipitation = log(annual_precipitation),
  ) |>
  # Let's also collect the mean rinafall for each species, and a value of rainfall centered around the mean
  group_by(taxon_name) |>
  mutate(
    log_annual_precipitation_mn = mean(log_annual_precipitation),
    log_annual_precipitation_c = log_annual_precipitation - log_annual_precipitation_mn
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(taxon_name, trait_name) |>
  mutate(
    log_value_c = log_value - mean(log_value)
  ) |>
  ungroup()


```

Fit model


```{r}
data_model <- data_traits_climate |> filter(!is.na(log_value) & !is.na(log_annual_precipitation), family == "Myrtaceae")

fit5 <- glmmTMB(log_value ~ log_annual_precipitation_mn + log_annual_precipitation_c + (log_annual_precipitation_c | taxon_name), data = data_model)

# Extract random effects from the fitted model
random_effects <- ranef(fit5)$cond$taxon_name
print(random_effects)

```


Make a plot
```{r}
parameters(fit5)

data_fit5 <- estimate_expectation(fit5) |>
  as_tibble()

data_fit5_global <-
  estimate_means(fit5, by = "log_annual_precipitation_mn") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(log_annual_precipitation = log_annual_precipitation_mn, log_value = Mean) |>
  mutate(
    annual_precipitation = exp(log_annual_precipitation),
    value = exp(log_value),
    taxon_name = "average"
  )

data_fit5_mn <- estimate_expectation(fit5,
  data = data_fit5 |> mutate(log_annual_precipitation_c = 0)
) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(log_annual_precipitation_mn, taxon_name, log_value_mn = Predicted) |>
  distinct()

data_fit5_all <-
  data_fit5 |>
  rename(log_value = Predicted) |>
  select(-SE, -Residuals) |>
  left_join(
    by = c("log_annual_precipitation_mn", "taxon_name"),
    data_fit5_mn
  ) |>
  mutate(
    log_annual_precipitation = log_annual_precipitation_mn + log_annual_precipitation_c,
    annual_precipitation = exp(log_annual_precipitation),
    annual_precipitation_mn = exp(log_annual_precipitation_mn),
    value = exp(log_value),
    value_mn = exp(log_value_mn),
  )

taxa <- c("Eucalyptus globulus", "Eucalyptus camaldulensis", "Melaleuca quinquenervia", "Corymbia citriodora", "Leptospermum laevigatum")

data_model_taxa <- data_model |>
  filter(taxon_name %in% taxa) |>
  mutate(taxon2 = taxon_name)

data_fit5_taxa <- data_fit5_all |>
  filter(taxon_name %in% taxa) |>
  mutate(taxon2 = taxon_name)

p_fit <-
  data_fit5_all |>
  ggplot(aes(annual_precipitation, value, group = taxon_name)) +
  # raw data
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, col = "grey", data = data_model, stroke = 0) +
  # fitted lines
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5, col = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
  # highlight certain species
  geom_point(aes(group = taxon2), col = "orange", show.legend = FALSE, data = data_model_taxa, size = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(x = annual_precipitation_mn, y = value_mn, group = taxon2), alpha = 0.5, data = data_fit5_taxa, col = "red") +
  geom_line(aes(group = taxon2), col = "purple", alpha = 1, show.legend = FALSE, data = data_fit5_taxa) +
  geom_line(data = data_fit5_global, col = "red") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(y = "height", x = "annual rainfall") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  facet_wrap(~taxon2)

ggsave(p_fit, filename = "p_fit.png", width = 8, height = 6)
```
